summaryZh: Devaraj Lab 研究非生命物质如何组装形成生命。实验室合成人工细胞，开发促进脂质囊泡自组装、生长与复制的偶联反应，并发展研究现代细胞结构功能的化学工具。
researchQuestions: 非生命物质如何组装形成生命？
生物学得以产生所需的先决化学基础是什么？

evidence.quote: We are approaching this problem through the synthesis of artificial cells, developing coupling reactions that drive the self-assembly, growth, and reproduction of lipid vesicle assemblies. To guide our work, we are developing chemical tools to blueprint the structure and function of modern cells.

One of the most significant and challenging problems in chemical biology is understanding how non-living matter can assemble to form life. We are approaching this problem through the synthesis of artificial cells, developing coupling reactions that drive the self-assembly, growth, and reproduction of lipid vesicle assemblies.
Using this combined approach, we strive to understand the prerequisite chemistry from which biology can emerge.
